lines: In 1859, Bernhard Riemann guessed that every nontrivial zero of the zeta function lies on a single line: real part one half.
1859 年，黎曼猜测：zeta 函数的每一个非平凡零点，都落在同一条直线上，实部为二分之一。
It is still unproved. This project does not prove it either. This is what a proof machine has built around it, and exactly where it stops.
至今无人证明。这个项目也没有证明它。这里是一台证明机器围绕它建造的一切，以及它精确的止步之处。
The zeta function listens to the primes. Its zeros are where all the prime waves cancel.
zeta 函数聆听素数。它的零点，是所有素数之波相互抵消的地方。
Over a hundred Lean files in one folder alone, each one checked by the kernel. None of them says the hypothesis is true.
仅一个文件夹里就有一百多个 Lean 文件，每一个都经内核核验。没有一个说这个猜想为真。
What is proved, unconditionally. There is a complete list of every nontrivial zero, each at exactly one index. It is infinite, and the reflection s to one minus s permutes it.
无条件证明的部分。存在一张完整的清单，列出每一个非平凡零点，每个恰好出现一次。它是无限的，而反射 s 到一减 s 置换这张清单。
Above some height, a zero lies within a fixed distance of every height. And the Weil explicit formula, linking zeros to primes, is proved with no hypothesis at all.
超过某个高度之后，每一个高度附近固定距离内都有一个零点。而把零点与素数连在一起的 Weil 显式公式，在没有任何假设的情况下被证明。
Can symmetry alone force the zeros onto the line? No. A small polynomial has every symmetry of zeta, and all four of its zeros sit off the line. Kernel-checked.
对称性能单独把零点逼到这条线上吗？不能。一个小多项式拥有 zeta 的全部对称性，而它的四个零点全都离开这条线。经内核核验。
And local is not global: at minus two, every prime factor and every finite product is nonzero, yet zeta itself is zero.
局部也不等于整体：在负二处，每一个素数因子、每一个有限乘积都不为零，而 zeta 本身却等于零。
At the center of the project sit two open hearts. One is a golden Euler germ. The other is Weil positivity. Neither is proved.
项目的中心有两颗敞开的心脏。一颗是黄金欧拉胚芽，另一颗是 Weil 正性。两者都没有被证明。
The owner wrote beside them: although I think off-line zeros exist, it is fine to try to prove the hypothesis, because the process produces a great deal of truth.
主人在旁边写道：虽然我认为二分之一离线零点存在，但我们去证明黎曼猜想没问题，因为这个过程会产生大量真理。
Weil's criterion, now kernel-checked: the hypothesis holds exactly when a certain sum over primes is nonnegative on every convolution square.
Weil 判据，如今经内核核验：猜想成立，当且仅当某个关于素数的和，在每一个卷积平方上都非负。
And the separator: any single off-line zero produces a test function that drives the sum negative. The difficulty has been moved, not removed. This positivity is as hard as the hypothesis.
还有分离器：任何一个离线零点，都会产生一个让这个和变负的测试函数。困难被移动了，而不是被移除。这个正性与猜想本身同样困难。
The Li coefficients. The first is exactly one plus gamma over two, minus the log of two root pi, about 0.023. Its positivity is proved in Lean.
李系数。第一个恰好是一加欧拉常数的一半，减去二倍根号 pi 的对数，约为 0.023。它的正性在 Lean 中被证明。
If every Li coefficient is nonnegative, the hypothesis follows, also proved. Feed in four fake zeros just off the line, and the thirty-first Li sum turns negative.
如果每一个李系数都非负，猜想就成立，这同样已证明。放入四个略离开临界线的假零点，第三十一个李和就变成负的。
Change coordinates, and the critical line becomes the unit circle. The hypothesis says every zero has one minus one over rho of size exactly one.
换一个坐标，临界线就变成单位圆。猜想说：每一个零点的一减一除以 rho，大小恰好为一。
Split it in two halves. The even half, closure under reflection, already holds. What remains is purely relative: that all zeros share one real part.
把它拆成两半。偶数的一半，即在反射下封闭，已经成立。剩下的纯粹是相对的：所有零点共享同一个实部。
Robin's classical criterion: the hypothesis holds exactly when no number beyond 5040 is too rich in divisors.
Robin 的经典判据：猜想成立，当且仅当 5040 之后没有任何数的因子过于丰富。
In Lean: every number built only from 2, 3, 5 and 7 beyond 5040 passes the test. But the margin creeps arbitrarily close to zero. There is no safety margin, ever.
在 Lean 中：5040 之后，每一个只由 2、3、5、7 构成的数都通过了检验。但余量会任意地逼近零。永远没有安全余量。
Suppose it failed. Then there is a first height where an off-line zero appears, proved in Lean. At that height, a mirror twin appears too.
假设它失败了。那么就存在一个出现离线零点的第一高度，在 Lean 中证明。在那个高度上，一个镜像双胞胎也同时出现。
The Mahler measure jumps from zero to positive, kernel-checked. Yet the first-order ledger cancels exactly. The break would be a sudden phase transition, invisible to a first glance.
马勒测度从零跳到正值，经内核核验。然而一阶账本恰好相消。这次破裂会是一次突然的相变，第一眼看不见。
The golden route. Rescaling by the golden ratio squared sends a structural line onto the critical line. The factorization is proved.
黄金路线。用黄金比的平方重新缩放，把一条结构线送到临界线上。这个分解已被证明。

But the machine found a certified off-line zero of the local factor at the prime two, within ten to the minus eight. The naive golden equivalence is false as designed, and a beautiful bridge conjecture was refuted by the kernel.
但机器在素数二的局部因子上，找到了一个经认证的离线零点，精度在十的负八次方之内。朴素的黄金等价，按原设计是假的；一个美丽的桥梁猜想，被内核推翻。
Dozens of equivalent pictures: Herglotz functions, scattering poles on one quarter, a squared shadow on the negative axis, a positive quantum chain at every order.
几十幅等价的图景：Herglotz 函数，落在四分之一线上的散射极点，负实轴上的平方投影，每一阶都为正的量子链。
Along the way, published conjectures were refuted and kernel-frozen. Truth accumulates either way.
一路上，已发表的猜想被推翻并由内核冻结。无论哪个方向，真理都在积累。
Every road ends at the same missing bridge: from the primes to positivity. The channel is known. The positivity is not.
每一条路都止于同一座缺失的桥：从素数到正性。通道已知，正性未知。
The two hearts are two faces of one wall. The door is still marked open, and the machine will record the truth, whichever way it falls.
两颗心脏本是一堵墙的两面。门上仍标着 open，而无论真相落向哪一边，机器都会把它记下来。
